headline: Nvidia's share price hit a new all-time high on Monday, taking the chipmaker's market value to about $5.8 trillion.
score_reason: Pool score 6 kept: a new record for the leading AI chip company, confirmed by Yahoo Finance and Reuters, but a share-price record is not a forecast.
importance_line: Anyone whose pension or share fund holds Nvidia gains from the record, which suggests investors still back AI spending, but the article itself lists bubble worries and growing competition from rival chips as open doubts.
summary: Yahoo Finance reports that Nvidia's share price hit a new all-time high during trading on Monday, climbing to $239.86 by the afternoon and lifting the chipmaker's market value (the price of all its shares together) to as much as $5.78 trillion, and Reuters adds that the shares ended the day at a record close, valued at $5.76 trillion. This follows the Friday record that Bloomberg reported and we carried in our 3 Oct 2026 edition, when the shares touched a high but closed just short of it, so the new fact today is a record close.
notes: Yahoo Finance's own article (Daniel Howley), read in full. Record close taken from the Reuters market wrap (AOL copy). Follow-up of our 3 Oct 2026 edition item (Bloomberg, 2 Oct).
